articles.title: MongoDB Associate Developer 2026: The NoSQL Cert for App Builders
articles.excerpt: MongoDB Associate Developer: ~75 questions, 75 min, $200 USD, no prerequisites. The document database cert for Python and JS developers — CRUD, aggregation pipelines, indexing, Atlas, and schema design. Avg salary $100k–$145k.

articles.title: FinOps Certified Practitioner 2026: Cloud Cost Cert Guide
articles.excerpt: FinOps FOCP 2026: 100 questions, 120 min, $300 USD, 70% pass. The cloud financial management credential that bridges engineers and finance teams — Inform, Optimize, Operate phases across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

articles.title: HashiCorp Vault Associate 002: Secrets Management Cert 2026
articles.excerpt: Vault Associate 002: ~57 questions, 60 min, ~70% to pass, $70.50 USD. HashiCorp's secrets management cert for DevOps engineers securing Kubernetes, cloud, and multi-cloud environments with dynamic credentials, Transit encryption, and Vault Agent.

articles.title: ISACA CRISC 2026: The Risk Management Cert for IT Leaders
articles.excerpt: CRISC: 150 questions, 4 hours, 450/800 to pass, ~$575 USD for members. Four domains cover governance, IT risk assessment, risk response and reporting, and IT security — one of the five highest-paying IT certifications in 2026.

articles.title: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate 2026 Guide
articles.excerpt: Databricks DE Associate: 45 questions, 120 min, $200 USD, 70% to pass. The Apache Spark + Delta Lake cert for data engineers — ETL pipelines, Databricks Workflows, Unity Catalog, and Delta Live Tables.

articles.title: Microsoft DP-600: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate 2026
articles.excerpt: DP-600: ~50 questions, 100 min, $165 USD, 700/1000 to pass. Microsoft Fabric's unified analytics cert — Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Real-Time Intelligence, Power BI semantic models, and Fabric governance.

articles.title: CKA 2026: Kubernetes Administrator Cert Update and Study Guide
articles.excerpt: CKA 2026: 15–20 performance-based tasks, 2 hours, $395 USD (includes one free retake). CNCF updated the curriculum in early 2025 — covers Kubernetes 1.32, Gateway API, CiliumNetworkPolicy, Helm, and kustomize.

articles.title: KCNA 2026: The Easiest CNCF Cert and Why It Matters
articles.excerpt: KCNA: 60 questions, 90 min, $250 USD (includes one free retake), 75% to pass. CNCF's entry-level cloud-native cert covers Kubernetes fundamentals, container orchestration, cloud-native observability, GitOps, and service mesh.
